entities.name: Tassilo von Heydebrand und der Lasa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tassilo, Baron von Heydebrand und der Lasa was a German chess master, chess historian and theoretician of the nineteenth century, a member of the Berlin Chess Club and a founder of the Berlin Chess School.
